sessions.title: Intonation before vocabulary
sessions.intent: Make pitch arrival, muting, and release credible before adding speed or density.

useCase.title: Slow-blues response phrases
useCase.copy: Two-bar answers over a sparse 12-bar scaffold.

gear.title: Clear attack, long decay
gear.copy: Low-gain compression, restrained drive, short delay, clean headroom.

sessions.space: Leave beat four empty after every answer.

stages.title: Arrival drill
stages.copy: Match target pitch, then remove visual correction.

stages.title: Two-note answers
stages.copy: Use one stable tone and one expressive arrival.

stages.title: Record evidence
stages.copy: Capture three passes and identify the largest defect.

sessions.title: Rhythm before sweep range
sessions.intent: Treat the pedal as a timing and articulation device rather than a continuous effect.

useCase.title: Muted sixteenth-note hook
useCase.copy: One-bar call-and-response over a restrained rock groove.

gear.title: Controlled midrange motion
gear.copy: Compressor before wah, modest drive, noise gate only as needed.

sessions.space: Mute the final eighth note of every second bar.

stages.title: Quarter-note centres
stages.copy: Land the pedal consistently on the beat.

stages.title: Syncopated accents
stages.copy: Move only on selected sixteenth-note attacks.

stages.title: Record evidence
stages.copy: Check whether pedal motion strengthens or obscures the groove.

sessions.title: Activation without the swell becoming the phrase
sessions.intent: Control entry timing, string changes, and decay so the sustained line serves the arrangement.

useCase.title: Drone and counterline
useCase.copy: A sparse upper-register response over a D–G movement.

gear.title: Stable sustain, low noise
gear.copy: Clean guitar, restrained compression, long but quiet delay return.

sessions.space: Wait one full dotted quarter before answering.

stages.title: Activation point
stages.copy: Produce repeatable entries at three dynamic levels.

stages.title: String transition
stages.copy: Cross strings without an uncontrolled volume spike.

stages.title: Record evidence
stages.copy: Review entry timing, pitch centre, and arrangement space.

sessions.title: Country articulation as a colour layer
sessions.intent: Add snap, separation, and chord-tone targeting without turning the session into a separate curriculum.

useCase.title: Eighties-rock turnaround
useCase.copy: Apply selective double-stops and open-string pull-offs to a familiar rock cadence.

gear.title: Fast clean response
gear.copy: Strat or PRS split-coil sound, light compression, minimal ambience.

sessions.space: Cap each phrase at six notes and leave the next beat empty.

stages.title: String-pair control
stages.copy: Alternate pick and fingers without volume imbalance.

stages.title: Chord-tone target
stages.copy: Resolve each lick to the next chord, not the scale box.

stages.title: Record evidence
stages.copy: Decide whether the country layer supports or distracts from the core sound.

techniques.name: Slide
techniques.copy: Pitch, vibrato, muting, arrival, and release.

techniques.name: Wah
techniques.copy: Rhythmic control, vowel shape, accents, and range.

techniques.name: E-Bow
techniques.copy: Activation, sustain, drones, counterlines, and texture.

techniques.name: Country branch
techniques.copy: Hybrid picking, snap, voice leading, and vocabulary.
